requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The court name on the caption line at the top of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed track registry records venue only as "Statewide Arizona law; petition in superior court." and records no county venue rule, so the platform holds no value for which superior court this petition is filed in and this build may not choose one
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: The name of the Arizona superior court this petition is filed in. No committed record this packet binds states a county venue rule - the committed track registry records venue only as "Statewide Arizona law; petition in superior court." - so the platform holds no value for it and this packet does not choose a county for you. Ask an Arizona superior court clerk which superior court takes a petition under A.R.S. § 13-4051 in your case, and write that court's name on this line before you file.
